info.title: - BUILD
info.description: BuildXL dotnet tool. BuildXL is a build engine for large-scale distributed, cached, and incremental builds. Install with: dotnet tool install -g agtest.bxl.tool

options.name: /config
options.description:
Configuration file that determines BuildXL's
behavior (short form: /c)

options.name: /additionalConfigFile
options.description:
Additional configuration files that can contain
module definitions (short form: /ac)

options.name: /qualifier
options.description:
Qualifiers controlling what flavor to build
(short form: /q)

options.name: /objectDirectory
options.description:
Specifies the root directory for primary build
outputs (short form: /o)

options.name: /tempDirectory
options.description:
directories. When unspecified, temp directories
will be created under the per-pip object
directories.

options.name: /property
options.description:
Specifies a property that overrides an allowed
environment variable (short form: /p)
